ephemeral_contract.exclusion_rule: A retry seed that is already a frozen seed is skipped; the attempt counter advances until an unused seed is found.
ephemeral_contract.identity: The ephemeral instance carries its own question id (-EPH-{attempt}) so that it cannot be confused with the frozen instance.
ephemeral_contract.persistence: never persisted; the instance lives in the in-memory session only.

policy_label: PROPOSED training policy (N20): 28 families x 4 variants = 112 instances, point weights and minute budgets are proposals. Official programme facts: seven topics, a written-on-paper examination and a maximum of 180 minutes.

ephemeral_path.claim: The ephemeral retry path draws a seed outside the frozen set, is deterministic, never collides with a frozen question id and is never persisted.

parity_fixture.claim: The frozen and the ephemeral instance are graded by identical engine code and yield the same verdict class for equivalent submissions.

smoke_vector.claim: The in-file smoke vector runs against the built artifact.

suite.note: The other in-file vectors walk a browser DOM; only the bank vector is asserted in this sandbox.

tamper_fixture.claim: The loader verifies the island digest at load time and refuses a tampered or unsigned island instead of loading it.
